capabilities.name: claim
capabilities.description: Take, renew or release an exclusive working lease on an issue. Idempotent for the same claimant; self-healing when stale; blocks competing transitions.

capabilities.signature_note: Lease, not flag: CAS-guarded claim/renew/release with staleness detection; a competing transition is refused with conflict until release or expiry.
